title: The Regenerative Practitioner, Lisbon cohort
description: Learn regenerative development by working with a real project, alongside practitioners from many places and fields. Open to people anywhere, with a special welcome for Europe and Portugal. Co-taught by Nuno da Silva and Constança Belchior of Lucida. Sliding-scale discounts and scholarships are offered. January to June 2027; Online, with a three-day intensive at Gandum Village, near Lisbon; Paid, with sliding scale and scholarships. Offered by Regenesis Institute for Regenerative Practice. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
